brief:
Georgian police confronted Besiktas supporters during a match against Israeli team Hapoel Beer-Sheva in Tbilisi, Al Jazeera English reported. The clash erupted after fans displayed a Palestinian flag, prompting a 30-minute suspension of the game. Details of injuries or arrests were not immediately available.

Besiktas, based in Istanbul, has a history of political activism among its fan base. The incident occurred as Israeli sports teams continue to participate in international competitions across various countries.
dek: Match between Besiktas and Hapoel Beer-Sheva suspended for 30 minutes after confrontation between fans and police.
title: Turkish fans clash with Georgian police over Palestinian flag
